meta.title: Elias Neto — Full Stack Developer
meta.description: Portfolio of Elias Neto, a full stack developer in Uberlândia, Brazil, building mobile apps, web dashboards and APIs with TypeScript, React Native, Next.js and NestJS.

hero.middle: end to end — fast, accessible and full of

projects.cartanoel: Live product: you share a child's name and a few details and get a letter from Santa written by AI, with a PDF kit and a certificate to share. React 19 and Vite on the front; Bun, Elysia and PostgreSQL on the back; better-auth, Stripe (card and Pix) and an LLM via OpenRouter.
projects.b2b: B2B portal built end to end with Next.js, NestJS, TypeORM and PostgreSQL, integrated with the Senior ERP.
projects.banking: Multi-tenant banking VAN platform with microservices, RabbitMQ and MongoDB. I built the sign-in screens: 2FA, passkeys, magic link and social login.
projects.vendora: React Native mobile app with Expo and Expo Router, its own API, authentication and credentials kept in SecureStore.
projects.niveela: Design System for a scheduling platform: CSS design tokens, responsive theme and WCAG AA (checked contrast, 44px targets, visible focus, reduced motion).
projects.pokemon: Pokémon challenge game: draft your team, build moves, items and EVs and beat a run of trainers. Battles run on the Showdown simulator, with an AI that computes real damage using the Smogon calculator.
projects.fifa: Build Brazil's line-up with the best players from every World Cup: drag and drop, formations and position filters. A project from my technical course at SENAC.
projects.portfolio: This site: Next.js 16 in three languages, flash-free theming, a holographic card and an MDX blog, with tests and an accessibility audit.
